versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the PatentFig AI Patent Drawing skill.
- Generate USPTO/EPO-compliant patent figures from text prompts as line art (PNG/SVG).
- Vectorize existing drawings to SVG, DXF, or vector PDF formats.
- Enhance (AI-upscale) and convert images for patent filing (TIFF, PDF, PNG).
- Requires a PATENTFIG_API_KEY environment variable for all operations.
- Communicates credit costs and requires user confirmation before billable actions.
